explain.coarseEstimates: estimates are coarse: the gate scores them only with explain fail-closed
limit.unjudged: cannot be judged before it is applied: {error}
limitUse.readsAfterWrites: reads after writes and in transactions
privilege.readsBack: reads after writes run on this connection and need SELECT
privilege.uncheckable: the privilege could not be checked: {error}
returning.lastInsertId: no RETURNING: exec + last insert id
setting.pooled: {variable} is a session setting a transaction pooler does not keep
timeout.dsnSetsVariable: the DSN sets {variable}, so cost.queryTimeout is not applied natively
timeout.mysqlWriteKilled: KILL QUERY at the request deadline (max_execution_time stops SELECT only)
timeout.mysqlWritePooled: max_execution_time stops SELECT only, and behind a transaction pooler a statement past its deadline cannot be stopped (KILL QUERY could reach another client's session): bound writes on the database side (DBA)
timeout.none: none: cost.queryTimeout is 0, so no statement timeout is set (the database's and the account's own defaults still apply)
timeout.postgresCancelOnly: a cancel request at the request deadline (the DSN sets its own statement_timeout)
timeout.postgresPooled: statement_timeout is a session setting a transaction pooler does not keep; a cancel request at the request deadline stops the statement only if the pooler forwards it
timeout.postgresStatementTimeout: statement_timeout just under cost.queryTimeout, and a cancel request at the request deadline
unkeyedWrite.dsnOff: the DSN turns sql_safe_updates off; the gate's WriteGuard still refuses unkeyed writes
unkeyedWrite.dsnUnclear: the DSN sets sql_safe_updates to {value}, which cannot be judged; the gate's WriteGuard still refuses unkeyed writes
unkeyedWrite.gateOnly: no database-side refusal; the gate's WriteGuard refuses unkeyed writes
validation.capabilityDenied: entity {entity}: {action} is granted, but connection {connection} cannot run it ({cause})
validation.limitNotEnforced: hard limit not enforced on the database side: datasource {datasource}, connection {connection}: {key} for {use} is {strength} ({cause})
